title: Document post-reap process-group signalling defect and connected repair
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The common runner selected by #6864 can reap its direct child and then signal the child's old process-group number from `finally`. If that number is reused while the runner is descheduled, the signal can target an unrelated group. A held pidfd does not reserve the numeric namespace lookup used by `killpg`.

This focused source audit records the counterexample under the selected Linux v6.12 model, the exact affected runner, primary-source pins, a proposed connected correction and its required discriminating controls. The package is `research/h25-group-retirement-audit`. It preserves the current native launch flag and the existing factory/cwd and timer/error corrections. The proposed correction remains unimplemented and unexecuted. No theorem, selected frontier, measured gain or runtime qualification changes.

## Task and overlap

Original investigation: #6321. Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. Affected #6864 head: `c8f7bd582ffc1301b851dde2364c60f1636aac8b`; prior connected assembly #6863: `c009a7514790e865b664ab8cd4688d37787d7eaa`.

The #6830 runner at `39fcd67c991bd72918080b1d2c02feb3d679206d` excludes its final kill after consumed/committed wait states. Its ownership discipline is a concrete repair predecessor, but its relay, funding and command interfaces are not a drop-in common-runner replacement. #6837/#6847 retain the separate genuine predecessor-baseline adoption obligation; #6762 retains the complete-outcome CLOSE obligation.

Bounded all-author/all-state behavior searches included `killpg`, `start_new_session`, `WNOWAIT` and `post-reap`. The inspected merged #4686 at `de93ebd044d0b00a8647a9f47f86939a6b18b9aa` fixes Windows Git stdin errors, a different contract. Exact dispositions and search limits are retained. No global novelty is claimed.

Scope is refined from a constructive preservation inquiry to a demonstrated negative source result and explicit repair handoff. Implementation dispatch stopped at the fixed thirty-minute reassessment before the complete Pro response arrived; publication does not reopen that round.

## Validation

Codex checked the complete Pro answer against the exact affected runner and the selected Linux v6.12 PID allocation/removal, numeric signal lookup and non-consuming wait source paths. The explicit wait-before-final-signal trace establishes the defect without a newly selected CPython patch release. Official CPython v3.12.3 polling is corroborating source only.

No project code, regression, kernel/native operation, guardian, compiler or scientific workload was run. The proposed tests are acceptance checks, not reported passes. This ten-file archive has a raw-byte SHA256/Git-blob manifest and no replay hook; hosted planning and skipped replay carry no scientific credit. Complete helper/context coverage, actual source/environment association, full comparison, resource fit, retention/CLOSE and physical costs remain unresolved. Outside and physical costs remain `OPEN_NOT_ZERO`.

## Credit

Tekalign, with substantial OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro assistance. Predecessor authors and source-specific notices are preserved. Linux and CPython are referenced under their existing licenses; Linux source bodies are not copied or relicensed here. This is bounded AI source review, not human or proof-kernel acceptance.

## Open next questions

Implement a single connected successor: non-consuming terminal observation, final numeric signal while the child remains owned and unreaped, then consuming wait; preserve actual first/cleanup errors. Update the authentic caller's runner pin, both complete source recipes and detached bindings together, then run the distinct reuse/ownership/error controls and obtain exact-source review. Keep the genuine primary baseline on that same common owner when it is later adopted.

The [maintained goal, PR map and contributor handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321#issuecomment-6713710045) records the wider obligations. A new research window, execution allowance, successful comparison or original completion is not granted by this publication.
